support_claim: Billing invoices and the Companies House registry row 11847201 both name Helion Robotics Limited, and commercial notes state that invoice and registry names refer to the same legal entity.

propositions.proposition: Commercial notes state that Helion Robotics Ltd is the CRM operating name, while invoices use Helion Robotics Limited.
propositions.relevance: Describes naming variants around the billing-side referent billing:Helion Robotics Limited without linking it to registry:11847201.

propositions.proposition: Commercial notes state that invoices and Companies House use Helion Robotics Limited and that this is the same legal entity.
propositions.relevance: Links the invoice/billing legal name Helion Robotics Limited to the Companies House-registered legal entity of that name, bearing on whether billing:Helion Robotics Limited and a registry record for that name denote the same counterparty.

propositions.proposition: Commercial notes state that Helion Industrial Systems Ltd is a different company that sold sensors in 2018 and has no current MSA.
propositions.relevance: Establishes that a similarly named Helion entity is distinct from the Helion Robotics counterparty under review, reducing risk of conflating alternate Helion companies with billing:Helion Robotics Limited or registry:11847201.

propositions.proposition: Company registry row 11847201 records the company name HELION ROBOTICS LIMITED with jurisdiction England and Wales and status active.
propositions.relevance: Grounds registry:11847201 to the legal name HELION ROBOTICS LIMITED, the registry-side referent in the candidate identity judgment.

propositions.proposition: Billing invoices record billed_name Helion Robotics Limited.
propositions.relevance: Grounds the billing-side referent billing:Helion Robotics Limited to the legal name Helion Robotics Limited used on invoices.
